name: anomalift
displayName: Anomalift — turn repeated agent errors into fixes
description: Find the mistakes your coding agent repeats, and the rules that stop them.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No failure patterns yet.

Anomalift reads Claude Code sessions from ~/.claude/projects — the CLI and this editor's extension share that store.

[Scan sessions](command:anomalift.refresh)

If scanning fails, anomalift is probably not on your PATH.
[Set the anomalift path](command:anomalift.configure)

commands.title: anomalift: Scan sessions for repeated failures
anomalift: Set path to the anomalift binary

anomalift.path.description: Path to the anomalift binary. Leave empty to search PATH and the workspace target directory.

anomalift.sessions.description: How many recent sessions to scan.

anomalift.scanOnStartup.description: Scan when the window opens. Off by default: scanning reads every transcript, and doing that unasked on a large history is rude.

scripts.verify: npm run compile && node verify.js && node smoke.js
